t: Weatherhaven and Supacat partner to advance redeployable infrastructure
d: Announced at Land Forces 2026 in Perth, the agreement pairs Weatherhaven infrastructure with Supacat’s high-mobility vehicles and regional support network across the Asia-Pacific — from the Antarctic to the North Pacific.
Weatherhaven announced its participation in Battlefield 2027, an independent defence innovation showcase in Washington, D.C., October 12–14, 2026, featuring TRECC.

t: Weatherhaven to attend LAND FORCES 2026 in support of Supacat Asia Pacific
d: Weatherhaven joins Supacat Asia Pacific at Australia’s premier land defence industry event.
